about: The graduale of the formulary “Palm Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: You have held me by my right hand, and by Your will You have led me, and with glory You have received me. How good God is to Israel, to the upright in heart! But my feet were almost moved, my steps had almost slipped, because I was envious of sinners, seeing the peace of sinners.

a.g: but my feet were almost moved
